summaries.Romania: Romania faces economic headwinds with the EU forecasting a mild 0.3% contraction in 2026 amid fiscal consolidation efforts, while administrative reform debates intensify between governing parties. NATO reaffirms support for Romania's Black Sea security but offers no concrete new capabilities yet.
summaries.Healthcare: US loses measles elimination status as vaccination rates sag and public health fractures deepen, while CMS releases new AI roadmap for healthcare adoption and obesity drugs emerge as the next access-to-medicines battleground globally.
summaries.Tech: Apple expands iPhone Duo optimization and Face Unlock capabilities while tightening macOS AI agent permissions, OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 models, and NSA's classified communications network experiences significant outage affecting national security operations.

items.title: Comisia Europeană: România va avea o recesiune ușoară în acest an. Restrângerea deficitului se face cu prețul creșterii economice
items.snippet: Comisia Europeană estimează că în 2026 economia României se va micșora cu 0,3%. Este o recesiune ușoară, iar cauza principală sunt măsurile luate pentru a reduce deficitul bugetar. Prognoza Bruxellesului spune că revenirea vine în 2027, dar va fi lentă: creștere de 1,8%, apoi 2,2% în 2028. De ce sca
items.line: EU forecasts Romania's 0.3% GDP contraction in 2026 due to fiscal consolidation, impacting consumer spending and growth recovery delayed until 2027.

items.title: U.S. loses measles elimination status, marking embarrassing stain on its public health record
items.snippet: Measles is no longer considered eliminated in the U.S., a finding that was expected but that marks an embarrassing backslide in the country’s basic public health standing.
items.line: US loses measles elimination status for first time, marking public health embarrassment driven by sagging vaccination rates and fractured federal health leadership.
